run_cosine_similarity_matrix: run the script to build a cosine similarity matrix for the ImageNet validation set
build_imagenet_val_dataset: build an ImagenetValDataset with resize, tensor, and normalization transformations for ImageNet validation images
create_dataloader: create a DataLoader with batch size 500 and 8 workers for the ImageNet validation dataset
calculate_pairwise_cosine_similarity: calculate pairwise cosine similarity between image chunks using torch.nn.functional.cosine_similarity
save_cosine_similarity_matrix: save the computed cosine similarity matrix as a NumPy .npy file to disk
